fields.description: The Arbor Process Rule (rule_ref) that opened this expectation. One expectation exists per (run, rule_key, expected_column).
fields.label: Rule Key

fields.description: The expected Tree Column this expectation tracks (one of the rule's expected_columns).
fields.label: Expected Column

fields.description: When the trigger fired and this expectation opened (SLA clock start).
fields.label: Opened At

fields.description: When the expected column was filled (expectation satisfied); null until satisfied.
fields.label: Satisfied At

fields.description: opened_at + within_seconds; null when the rule has no SLA (within_seconds=0).
fields.label: Due At

fields.description: Set by the SLA sweep when now > due_at and the expectation is not yet satisfied.
fields.label: Breached

fields.description: Idempotency guard for the expect-open notification (records the notified owner marker so a replay does not re-notify).
fields.label: Notified Owner
